statement_nl: For every finite simple connected graph G, Ls(G) >= max_v l(v) + (max_v T(v)) * cC4(G), where Ls(G) is the maximum number of leaves over all spanning trees, l(v) = alpha(G[N(v)]) is the local independence number, T(v) is the number of triangles of G containing v (equivalently the number of adjacent pairs inside N(v)), and cC4(G) = 1 if G has no cycle of length 4 (not necessarily induced) and 0 otherwise.
statement_formal:
theorem conjecture160 (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.Connected) :
    let maxL := (Finset.univ.image (indepNeighborsCard G)).max' (by simp)
    let maxT := maxTrianglesAtVertex G
    let cC4 : ℕ := if ∃ v : α, ∃ c : G.Walk v v, c.IsCycle ∧ c.length = 4 then 0 else 1
    (maxL : ℝ) + (maxT : ℝ) * (cC4 : ℝ) ≤ Ls G := by
